description: The one A3-v3 move (SER5, workers 4) that left its E3-A game with no deadline event on that move: 8416/23 white, ply 21, a tree move (TB-Engine-v1 [7, 9] in 2.6 s, v3 [4, 6] in 1.5 s, both games won). Replayed with --trace to tell a SER5 policy evaluation difference (tb1 also differs), a v3 state bug (v3 with no time pressure differs) and a deadline effect on an earlier move (only v3 at 27.5 s differs; the random-state digests show the move).
